description: World mine/plant PRODUCTION (prior-year actual + current-year estimate) and RESERVES, by country, for one mineral commodity from the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries — e.g. "which countries hold lithium reserves" or "China vs. Australia rare-earth production". Covers 75 of the 85 commodities MCS tracks (the other 10 — mostly scrap/slag/crushed-stone categories USGS tracks only domestically — return found:false with a pointer to mcs_commodity_data instead). Optional `countries` filter (comma-separated or array) narrows to named countries; rows are otherwise sorted by current reserves, descending. Keyless.

countries.description: Optional country name filter — a comma-separated string or array, e.g. "China,Australia,Chile".

limit.description: Max countries to return, default 50, max 100.

name: mcs_country_comparison
title: Mcs Country Comparison
